# PageNumberOf

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders the resolved page number of a named section or a fallback placeholder.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `TextBlock`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new PageNumberOf(anchorTarget: string, options?: PageNumberOfOptions)
new PageNumberOf(options: PageNumberOfOptions & { anchorTarget: string; })
```

## Properties

- [`anchorTarget`](#anchortarget): The anchor id whose page number is printed.
- [`placeholder`](#placeholder): Text shown before the page is resolved (dry-run pass) or when the anchor id is unknown.

### `anchorTarget`

```typescript
anchorTarget: string
```

The anchor id whose page number is printed.

### `placeholder`

```typescript
placeholder: string
```

Text shown before the page is resolved (dry-run pass) or when the anchor id is unknown. Kept short and stable so it does not disturb pagination.

## Methods

- [`captureType`](#capturetype): Stable node name for the layout snapshot tree.
- [`renderStateful`](#renderstateful): Renders this text block with state tracking for pagination.

### `captureType`

```typescript
captureType(): string
```

Stable node name for the layout snapshot tree.

### `renderStateful`

```typescript
renderStateful(ctx: RenderContext, width: number): RenderStatus
```

Renders this text block with state tracking for pagination. Text that doesn't fit on the current page will be continued on the next page. Respects MinLinesBeforeBreak (orphan) and MinLinesAfterBreak (widow) settings.
